retrievalProfile.description: A gritty 1990s urban aesthetic blending Japanese anime character art with hip-hop street culture and airbrushed lighting effects.
triggerTerms: retro mixtape aesthetic with stencil text
excludeWhen: clean modern minimalist design is required
traditional fine art styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring a central anime-style warrior figure set against a dark, textured background with glowing vertical light beams and heavy, layered typography. The style mimics the low-fidelity, high-contrast look of 90s CD jewel case inserts.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical light beam bisecting the frame
Character positioned in the lower right quadrant
Heavy title text spanning the top edge
coreInvariants: High-contrast shadows with purple and red undertones
Layered graphic elements like metal plates or stickers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Anime character at 40% scale in the bottom right; large vertical beam at 20% width left of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow airbrushed glow at the base of the vertical beam.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, follows the vertical beam down to the glow, then moves right to the character and advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured voids in the upper left and behind the character to emphasize glowing elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and charcoal black for background depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and pale green for the vertical light beam.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for glows and red for character details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark backgrounds and neon-adjacent glows; mid-range saturation.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to high-contrast urban night colors

letterConstructionRules: Title uses ultra-bold condensed sans-serif with thick outlines
Vertical text uses stencil-style cutouts with irregular, hand-drawn edges
Secondary text appears on faux-metal plate graphics with rivet details
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the vertical sidebar have jagged, spray-painted edges
Title letters feature a gradient fill and a secondary drop shadow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, clean display face paired with raw, distressed stencil lettering.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top title.
Provides the base for the distressed vertical lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, textured urban-anime background featuring a purple-haired warrior in the lower right and a glowing cyan vertical beam. Include airbrushed yellow glows and faint red background symbols.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy condensed sans-serif title with a thick black outline at the top. Place a distressed white stencil-style vertical text block in a black sidebar on the left. Add a riveted metal plate graphic with black block text in the upper right.

verificationChecks: Is the vertical beam glowing with an airbrushed effect?
Is the left sidebar text distressed and stencil-like?
Does the top title have a prominent thick outline?
Is the character style consistent with 90s cel-shaded anime?

adjustableVariables: Color of the vertical light beam
Distress level of the stencil text
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure background symbols are generic and not specific trademarks
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the 'Parental Advisory' style box
Ensure the vertical beam bisects the composition effectively
Verify the airbrushed bloom doesn't obscure the text legibility
Confirm the color palette stays within the dark purple/cyan/yellow range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Anime Subject] + [Urban Night Texture] + [Vertical Light Beam] + [Heavy Outlined Title] + [Distressed Stencil Sidebar] to recreate this 90s hip-hop aesthetic.
